reason: Accendra delivers home respiratory, sleep, diabetes, wound care, urology and ostomy equipment and supplies to patients at home. UHS owns and operates acute care hospitals, behavioral health facilities and emergency and outpatient centers. The offerings differ: home equipment and supplies against facility-based care. Both serve patients and are paid largely by insurers and government programs, so customers and reimbursement overlap. That is overlap on customers only, not on product, which makes them adjacent.
